title: Kinematic Analysis of z = 4.3 Galaxies in the SPT2349─56 Protocluster Core
question: How do galaxies in the SPT2349-56 protocluster core move: are they rotating discs, and what are their rotation velocities, velocity dispersions, disc stability and dynamical support in a protocluster environment?

evidence.quote: See Table 1 in (cite: Hill_2020) for more details about the observations.
the seven FIR brightest sources listed in Table 3 of (cite: Hill_2020)

evidence.quote: of the half-light radius of the individual sources (see (cite: Hill_2020) for values)

evidence.quote: Here we use values presented in (cite: Rizzo_2020), where $\alpha_{\mathrm{CII}} = 7.3 \pm 1.2$ $M_\ensuremath{\odot}/L_\ensuremath{\odot}$.

recipe.goal: Image the continuum and the [CII] line cube
recipe.method: Concatenate the data, run tclean with MFS to make a continuum image from line-free channels, then build a cube with the same Briggs weighting and subtract the continuum with imcontsub
key_parameters: clean threshold 0.55 mJy (1.4 x dirty-cube RMS)

recipe.goal: Build SNR cube and SNR moment-0 map
recipe.method: Estimate noise per position from emission-free channels, divide each channel by the noise map, and sum consecutive channels with SNR > 2.5 (fixed 160 km/s window where no significant emission)
assumptions: Noise is mainly a function of position and almost constant along the frequency axis

recipe.goal: Detect sources and make masks with 3DBarolo SEARCH
recipe.method: Extract 2'' x 2'' sub-cubes (3'' x 3'' for C1) with imsubimage, run SEARCH with clipping only (5 sigma, grown to 2.1 sigma, 2.5 sigma for C1)
key_parameters: SEARCH keywords: SEARCHTYPE spatial, THRESHOLD 0.0025005, GROWTHTHRESHOLD 0.0010002, MINCHANNELS 5, MINPIX 1

recipe.goal: Derive initial guesses for the 3D fit
recipe.method: Take x0, y0, Vrot, Vsys from SEARCH (flux-weighted moment-0 centre, adjusted with moment-1 and p-v maps where not at the kinematic centre); phi from moment-1; i from the (b/a) axis ratio measured with fitcomponents; sigma_disp set arbitrarily
key_parameters: cos^2 i = ((b/a)^2 - q^2)/(1 - q^2) with q = 0.2; cos i = b/a for edge-on C1, C4, C5
assumptions: Intrinsic axis ratio q = 0.2 (mildly thick disc)

recipe.method: 3DFIT builds concentric-ring models, convolves with the beam, and chi-squared-minimises against the cube; two-stage fit with Bezier regularisation of geometry (phi, i) first, then kinematics; four free parameters per ring (Vrot, sigma_disp, phi, i); x0, y0, Vsys fixed
key_parameters: RADSEP = sqrt(theta_x theta_y)/2 (RADSEP 0.0968 in parameter file), near-Nyquist sampling
NORM = azimuthal; TWOSTAGE true; REGTYPE bezier; FREE vrot vdisp pa inc; MASK search
assumptions: Thin disc with scale height z0 = 1/10 of the half-light radius

recipe.goal: Derive mean rotation velocity, dispersion and V/sigma per source and for the sample
recipe.method: Noise-weighted mean of Vrot and sigma_disp over the rings beyond the beam size (r > 1.55 kpc); V/sigma uses Vrot = V_flat and sigma_disp = sigma_extended measured beyond 0.22''
key_parameters: Points within the beam size (< 1.55 kpc) excluded; at least three independent measurements per profile remain

recipe.goal: Classify rotators versus mergers with dynamical criteria
recipe.method: Test five literature criteria: smooth velocity gradient, V/sigma > 3, coincident centres (< 0.22''), kinematic and morphological axes within 30 deg, centrally peaked dispersion; plus p-v symmetry and double-peaked spectra

recipe.goal: Compute Toomre Q for disc stability
recipe.method: Q_T = sigma_disp kappa / (pi G Sigma_gas), with kappa = sqrt(2) Vrot/R and Sigma_gas from L_CII times alpha_CII per unit area; L_CII from the Solomon et al. 1997 relation with CO replaced by [CII]
assumptions: alpha_CII from Rizzo et al. 2020; the literature range is 5-30

recipe.method: Compute P_major, P_V, P_R from the p-v maps (Eqns. 6, 7, 8 of Rizzo et al. 2022) and classify with the dividing plane -0.63 P_major - 0.27 P_V + 2.78 P_R - 2.72 = 0

recipe.goal: Compare with simulations, analytic models and literature samples; assess protocluster interaction timescales
recipe.method: Compare V/sigma with TNG50 and with 3D-modelled ionized-tracer samples at other redshifts; test the Hayward and Hopkins sigma_disp prediction with f_gas = 0.7 and with Rotermund f_gas; estimate crossing and relaxation times of the core
assumptions: V_c = V_gas in the Hayward model since stellar and dark matter velocity contributions are not available

score_reason: Project code, observing outline, key imaging choices (robust 0.5, 13 km/s channels, 0.55 mJy clean) and full 3DBarolo parameter files with initial guesses are given, and results are numeric; but CASA version, calibration, many tclean settings and the Toomre Q inputs are missing, and some headline numbers disagree between sections.
rediscovery_reason: A single ALMA project code, a public fitting code with published parameter files and numeric headline results make a reasonable redo possible, though imaging details and the Toomre inputs must be inferred and the public status of the data is not stated by the paper.
